bibliographic.title: (un)twisting
bibliographic.author: time-to-occur
bibliographic.description:
If you want to know what you're getting into, this is a project about trans and queer identities as they relate to play through the lens of what it means for a work to be queer/trans and whether those definitions ultimately matter. It's also a personal exploration of my own identity through stories about play in contexts not always traditionally considered playful.

Content notes include: childhood embarrassments, discussions of gender, sexuality, dysphoria, kink (impact play, mind control/hypnosis, pain play), sexual arousal, identity, brief discussions of transphobia and violence, some graphic language, other potentially NSFW or spicy content.
